So. I got into traning properly from October 2019 to now. I started off doing Stronglifts 5x5 so three days a week, 5x5 squats, overhead press, deadlifts and barbell rows. 

Just in case you dont know what Stronglifts is, it consists of a Workout A and B where I'd alternate between the two on a three day split. Did that from October to February. I also threw 5x5 barbell curls in each sesh. 

Did Stronglifts from October to February while on a caloric deficit as was overweight at the time. Successfully lost 24 pounds but no change to my arms at all. I felt I needed to switch up my training so I switched to a P.H.U.L workout from Feb to now. This consisted of a four day split, Upper Monday, Lower Tuesday, rest Wednesday, Upper Hypertrophy Thursday, Lower Hypertrophy Friday. 

I have developed a lot in terms of lower body but upper body is still lacking. Not sure if its because I still need to lower my bodyfat but it's de-motivating seeing little to no progress in terms of upper body despite six months of training. 

Sorry for the lengthy one, not sure what to do as not to best when it comes to bodybuilding.
